column1: # Nuclear radii changes and rms charge radii, actinides.
# I. Angeli & K.P. Marinova, "Table of experimental nuclear ground state charge
# radii: An update", Atomic Data and Nuclear Data Tables 99 (2013) 69-95,
# delta<r^2> is relative to the element's reference isotope (the row with 0).
# For Z >= 36 the higher-moment (HM) correction has been applied by the authors.
# unc on delta<r^2> is STATISTICAL ONLY (the authors' own note).
# *** THE TABLE ENDS AT Z = 96. Bk (97) and Cf (98) are absent, confirming
# *** arXiv:2409.08193, states that this compilation gives NO UNCERTAINTY in
# *** the V2(Z) charge-distribution factor, that the missing sigma_CD is "up to
# *** 4 times larger" than the quoted totals, that from phosphorus onward it
# *** DOMINATES, and that "even larger missing uncertainties are expected for
# *** the heavier nuclei" — which is where these actinides sit. He also finds
# *** r(12C) 6 sigma and r(18Ne) 5 sigma from this table's values.
# *** His re-evaluation covers Z = 3-32 ONLY, so it does not correct these
# *** rows; it warns that their unc_R columns are LOWER BOUNDS.
